profile.headline: Full Stack Developer
profile.summary: I am a Full-Stack Developer with a passion for building high quality web and mobile applications. I specialize in building well-crafted MERN stack applications from ideation to product launch and beyond. I have over 11 years of professional experience shipping code for companies such as NBC News, EY, PwC, Dollar General, and many more. My deep knowledge of JavaScript allows me to have intermediate to expert knowledge of libraries and frameworks such as React, Angular, Next.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, D3.js, Three.js, Svelte, Gulp, and much, much more.

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.description:
Building mockups and wireframes using Adobe Photoshop, XD, or Sketch
Developing WordPress websites and applications using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and PHP. 
Building web and mobile applications using MongoDB, NodeJS, Angular, and ExpressJS
Manipulating databases and collections using MongoDB in the CLI (command line interface)
Creating, managing, and updating version control using Git and Github.
